email.subject: MV SKERRY DAWN - Krishnapatnam line-up: berth occupied
email.body:
Dear Operations,

MV SKERRY DAWN - Krishnapatnam, Krishnapatnam Bulk Terminal

The berth is occupied. The vessel ahead is expected to complete loading in two days. SKERRY DAWN is next in line, berthing about 29 Jan 1500 UTC, subject to the vessel ahead completing as planned.

We will advise at once if the line-up changes. Please keep us informed of the vessel's ETA.

Best regards,
Operations desk
Krishnapatnam Port Agency

summary: Voyage Agent reports: The berthing time of 29 Jan 1500 UTC is provided as "subject to the vessel ahead completing as planned," which indicates some uncertainty, but it is significantly later than the current ETA of 27 J...

result.result:
The berthing time of 29 Jan 1500 UTC is provided as "subject to the vessel ahead completing as planned," which indicates some uncertainty, but it is significantly later than the current ETA of 27 Jan 1500 UTC.

The voyage optimisation service's simulated figures suggest that reducing speed to 8.6 knots would result in an arrival at 29 Jan 12:55 UTC, saving 46 hours at anchor and 93 tonnes of VLSFO.

The operator should decide whether to order this reduced speed. If agreed, the following steps would be taken:
(a) a speed instruction to the Master with the advised speed (8.6 kn) and arrival (29 Jan 12:55 UTC), noting that his judgement for the safety of the ship in the weather ahead comes first;
(b) an ETA notice to the agent and receiver, as required by the CP, with the new ETA;
(c) a voyage management system entry updating the port call ETA for Krishnapatnam.

I recommend that nothing be sent until the operator answers.
